shared_elements: linear/geometric framing or border along the edges
repeated small signs arranged in rows or registers
vertical central axis organizing the composition
justification: Both surfaces organize marks around a strong vertical axis with repeated small units set in a bordered/registered scheme, but that is a generic compositional habit rather than a shared motif. A shows only austere incised linear geometry (a framed cross-like figure with rows of angular script signs and no figural imagery), while B shows dense high-relief figural sculpture — a frontal human-like being with elaborate foliate headdress and glyph-blocks, plus a seated onlooker — so the depicted content and rendering conventions have essentially nothing in common.
